T.topic_fa: وقتی همه‌چیز را می‌شود در چند ثانیه ساخت، زحمتِ دیده‌شده خودش پیام است
T.topic_en: When anything can be generated in seconds, visible effort becomes the message
T.central_tension_fa: ما با هوش مصنوعی محتوا را ارزان‌تر و سریع‌تر می‌سازیم تا بیشتر دیده شویم؛ ولی مشتری زحمت را نشانه‌ی اهمیت می‌خواند. هرچه ساختنش ارزان‌تر به نظر برسد، باورکردنش گران‌تر می‌شود.
T.central_tension_en: We use AI to make more, faster and cheaper, so we can be seen more. But customers read effort as care. The cheaper it looks to make, the more expensive it is to believe.
T.working_hook_fa: ۳۵ نفر، سه هفته، یک شهر کوچک با دست. برای فروش یک انگشتر.
T.working_hook_en: Thirty-five people. Three weeks. A tiny city, built by hand. To sell a ring.

key_sources.claim: 'Wear Your Best Life' campaign 'eschews AI'; a world 'crafted entirely by hands, for hands'; 35 modelmakers built a 1:10 city in Prague over three weeks; practical effects.
Build details: one-tenth scale, ~20-foot street, working subway cars, hand-carved brick walls, rooftop pool with real water; agency Nice & Frank, director Sam Walker.
Survey of 1,539 US consumers (Oct 2025): 50% would prefer to give their business to brands that do not use GenAI; 68% frequently wonder whether content they see is real. Stated preference, US only.
Coca-Cola's 2025 AI Christmas ad: ~50,000 posts, >1m engagements, 37% positive; John Lewis: ~21,000 posts, 83% positive. Social sentiment only, not sales.
Opinion: 'no AI' is becoming a premium selling point; brands (Oura, De'Longhi, Beefeater 0.0) advertise handmade craft. Etsy figures cited there are unverified; do not use.
Polaroid in-house outdoor campaign: 'AI can't generate sand between your toes.'

T.framing_note: Not an anti-AI sermon. The idea: effort is a signal people believe because it is hard to fake (strategist's interpretation, say 'my take'). Practical close: use the machine for what customers never see, spend human effort where they do. Caveat once: Gartner is a US survey of stated preference; Coca-Cola numbers are social sentiment, not sales. One number on screen at most (35 people / three weeks, or 50%). Do not use Etsy percentages. Do not use Apple Music (covered 2026-10-22). Oura's page lists rollout markets; never name the UAE, Dubai or any emirate in copy, caption or hashtags.
